_说明: 罗宾猫雷达的所有开关和数字（v1.0.0：程式里不留任何官方数字）。每条规则 = 开关 + 你自己填的数字；没开或没填就不套用。type=bool 是开关（floor=1 是底线，预设开、可以关），其他是数字（need = 管它的开关；没有 def，新安装是空的）。excl = 跟它互斥的开关。新增设定：在这里加一项（k 不能重复），再到 watch.mjs 的 applySettings()／NR_NEED 或 rh.mjs 的 apply() 接上。 每个策略要选「条件怎么组合」（combine：1 全部／2 任意一个／3 至少 N 个，combineN 不能超过开着的条件数）；cond＝这一项是哪个策略的条件；missOf＝「读不到这个资料时」（1 不买／2 用备用条件，没有跳过）；when＝只有在某个选项时才用；type=order 是卖出同时触发时的顺序。

items.zh: 🔒 底线 · 代码扫描挡危险合约
items.en: 🔒 Floor · Code scan blocks dangerous contracts
items.dzh: 自动买 AI 热门代币、一般新币、Robinhood 代币和铸造、BNB Chain NFT 之前，先读合约程式码：项目方还握有权限、而且能冻结交易／拉黑钱包／换掉合约（可升级合约一律挡）的就不自动买。AI 铸造代币项目不扫（铸造合约常有暂停功能）。手动买只提醒不挡
items.den: Before auto-buying hot tokens, new tokens, Robinhood tokens/mints and BNB Chain NFTs, read the contract: if the team still holds powers to freeze trading / blacklist wallets / swap the code (upgradeable contracts always), skip. AI token mints are not scanned. Manual buys only warn.
items.rzh: 关掉后，项目方能冻结交易、拉黑你的钱包、随时换掉合约程式的币也会被自动买进，可能买了卖不掉。
items.ren: If off, tokens whose team can freeze trading, blacklist your wallet or swap the contract code will be auto-bought — you may be unable to sell.

items.zh: 🔒 底线 · 一定要查到「能不能卖」才自动买
items.en: 🔒 Floor · Require a sell-check result before auto-buy
items.dzh: AI 热门代币、一般新币自动买之前，一定要从 honeypot.is 查到模拟卖出的结果（能卖、税多少）；查不到就不买。确定是貔貅（卖不掉）的由「自动买跳过貔貅」底线管
items.den: AI hot tokens and new tokens are auto-bought only when honeypot.is returns a sell-simulation result. Confirmed honeypots are handled by the "Auto-buy skips honeypots" floor.
items.rzh: 关掉后，查不到能不能卖、税多少的币也会自动买进，可能买到貔貅（买了卖不掉）或超高税的币。
items.ren: If off, tokens with no sell-check result are auto-bought — you may buy a honeypot (cannot sell) or a very high tax token.

items.zh: 🔒 底线 · 自动买跳过貔貅
items.dzh: AI 热门代币、一般新币自动买时，honeypot.is 模拟卖出失败（确定是貔貅、买了卖不掉）就不买。手动买只提醒，你按「我知道风险，仍然执行」才买
items.den: Auto-buys of AI hot tokens and new tokens skip tokens whose honeypot.is sell simulation fails (confirmed honeypot). Manual buys only warn; they go through after you confirm.
items.rzh: 关掉后，自动买会买进确定卖不掉的貔貅币，买进去的钱可能全部拿不回来。
items.ren: If off, auto-buy will buy confirmed honeypots — you may never be able to sell and lose the whole amount.

items.zh: 🔒 底线 · 钱包要留 BNB 付手续费
items.dzh: 买入、铸造、小工具交易时，钱包里要留下面填的 BNB，留着之后卖出付手续费。数字没填＝这条不生效：现在留 0 BNB（只检查这笔交易本身付不付得起）
items.den: Keep the BNB below in the wallet after buys/mints/add-on trades, for later sell gas. Empty = this floor does not apply: keeps 0 BNB (only checks this transaction can be paid).
items.rzh: 关掉后，雷达可能把 BNB 花光，之后想卖币时连手续费都付不起。
items.ren: If off, the radar may spend all BNB — later you may not even afford the gas to sell.

items.dzh: 每个钱包在 BNB Chain 买入或铸造之后至少还要剩这么多 BNB（单位 BNB）
items.den: BNB left in each wallet after a buy/mint

items.dzh: 自动铸造、或用 USDT 等别的币买的时候，钱包至少要有这么多 BNB（付手续费用），不够就不打（单位 BNB；没填 = 不另外设底线，付不付得起由预演决定）
items.den: Auto-mint, or buying with USDT etc., is skipped when the wallet holds less BNB than this (BNB; empty = no extra floor, the simulation decides)

items.dzh: 小工具（外挂：网格、定投…）买卖时，钱包至少留这么多 BNB（单位 BNB）
items.den: BNB to keep when add-ons trade

items.zh: 🔒 底线 · Robinhood 钱包要留 ETH 付手续费
items.en: 🔒 Floor · Keep ETH for gas on Robinhood
items.dzh: Robinhood 买入、铸造时，钱包要多留下面填的 ETH 付手续费。数字没填＝这条不生效：现在留 0 ETH（只检查这笔交易本身付不付得起）
items.den: Keep extra ETH for gas on Robinhood buys/mints. Empty = this floor does not apply: keeps 0 ETH (only checks this transaction can be paid).
items.rzh: 关掉后，Robinhood 上的 ETH 可能被花光，之后卖不出去（付不起手续费）。
items.ren: If off, ETH on Robinhood may be spent to zero and you cannot pay gas to sell.

items.zh: 用 ETH 买／铸造时多留
items.dzh: 用 ETH 付的时候，除了这笔金额还要多留这么多 ETH（单位 ETH）
items.den: ETH kept on top of the trade amount

items.zh: 用 USDG 付时至少要有
items.dzh: 用 USDG 付的时候，钱包至少要有这么多 ETH 付手续费（单位 ETH）
items.den: ETH needed for gas when paying with USDG

items.zh: 🔒 底线 · 送出前价格涨了就取消
items.en: 🔒 Floor · Cancel if price jumped before sending
items.dzh: 付费铸造送出前再查一次价格，比刚刚报的价贵超过下面的百分比就取消。下面没填数字＝这条不生效（不会当成 0%）
items.den: Re-check the mint price right before sending; cancel if it is higher than quoted by more than the % below. No number below = this floor does not apply (not treated as 0%).
items.rzh: 关掉后，项目方可以在你送出前把价格灌高，你会用比看到的更贵的价格铸造。
items.ren: If off, a project can raise the price right before you send and you pay more than quoted.

items.dzh: 比报价贵超过这个百分比就取消（单位 %）。没填＝上面的底线不生效
items.den: Cancel if price is higher by more than this %. Empty = the floor above does not apply

items.zh: 🔒 底线 · 按份数铸造：价格比你确认的高就取消
items.en: 🔒 Floor · Per-share mint: cancel if price > what you confirmed
items.dzh: 在详情页「按份数铸造」时，只付你在画面上看到、按确定的金额；送出时价格变高就取消（不加容差）
items.den: For per-share mints you pay only the amount you saw and confirmed; if the price is higher when sending, cancel (no tolerance).
items.rzh: 关掉后，按份数铸造会照送出当下的价格付钱，项目方可以在你按下前把价格灌高。
items.ren: If off, per-share mints pay the live price at send time — the project can raise it right before.

items.zh: 🔒 底线 · 铸造实际花费不能超过你设的金额
items.en: 🔒 Floor · Mint cost must stay within your amount
items.dzh: Robinhood 铸造和 BNB Chain NFT 铸造：预演显示要花的钱，不能超过你设的「一次铸造最多花」再加下面的容差（没填容差 = 一分都不能多）
items.den: Robinhood mints and BNB Chain NFT mints: the simulated cost must not exceed your per-mint amount plus the tolerance below (empty = no tolerance).
items.rzh: 关掉后，铸造时不再核对实际要付多少，项目方改价你也会照付。
items.ren: If off, the real mint cost is no longer checked — if the project raises the price you still pay.

items.dzh: 可以比设定多花几 %（单位 %）
items.den: May spend this % more than set

items.dzh: 再多加几 U（单位 U）
items.den: Plus this many U

items.dzh: 其他雷达回报过的诈骗合约、部署者，直接不打
items.den: Contracts/deployers reported as scams by other radars are skipped

items.zh: 买了很久没开池 → 部署者进自己的黑名单
items.en: Blacklist deployers whose coin never opened
items.dzh: 买了以后超过下面的时间还没开池，这个部署者发的币以后都不打（AI 铸造、AI 热门代币、一般新币都看这份名单）
items.den: If a coin you bought has no pool after the time below, skip everything from that deployer.

items.dzh: 买了以后超过几小时还没开池（单位 小时）
items.den: Hours after buying with no pool

items.dzh: 同一个地址在下面的时间内发了很多项目（批量割韭菜），它发的都不打
items.den: Skip deployers that launch many projects within the window below

items.dzh: 同一个部署者发了这么多个以上就不打（单位 个）
items.den: Number of projects from one deployer

items.dzh: 算上面数量的时间范围（单位 小时；没填 = 雷达记得的全部）
items.den: Time window (hours; empty = everything remembered)

items.zh: 部署者一直换名字发币不打
items.dzh: AI 热门代币、一般新币：同一个部署者在下面的时间内发了好几个不同名字的币，就不买
items.den: Hot/new tokens: skip if the deployer launched several different names within the window

items.dzh: 几个不同名字以上就不买（单位 个）
items.den: Number of different names

items.dzh: 算上面数量的时间范围（单位 小时；没填 = 雷达记得的全部）
items.den: Time window (hours; empty = all remembered)

items.zh: 同名仿盘不打，只认第一个
items.en: Same name: only the first one
items.dzh: 同时有好几个同名币时，只认最早发的那个，其他的不打（一般新币、Robinhood）
items.den: When several coins share a name, only the earliest counts (new tokens, Robinhood)

items.dzh: 一般新币：这段时间内出现的同名币只买第一个（单位 小时；没填 = 不限时间）
items.den: New tokens: same-name window (hours; empty = no limit)

items.dzh: AI 铸造项目：项目方能换掉合约规则的（代理／可升级合约）不打。有些正常项目也是这种合约，打开可能错过好项目
items.den: AI mints: skip proxy/upgradeable contracts. Some legit projects use them too.

items.zh: 先小额试水（第二个钱包等第一个）
items.dzh: AI 付费铸造：第一个钱包真的收到东西，第二个钱包才跟着打。等太久（下面的秒数）就不打了，不会照样打
items.den: Paid AI mints: the 2nd wallet mints only after the 1st really received something; after the wait below it gives up (never mints blind).

items.dzh: 第一个钱包这么久还没打成，第二个钱包就放弃这个项目（单位 秒；没填 = 一直等）
items.den: If the first wallet has not minted after this, the second gives up (seconds; empty = wait forever)

items.zh: NFT 图片连结是假的就不打
items.en: Skip NFTs with fake image links
items.dzh: NFT 的图片连结是空的或乱填的（批量掏手续费的垃圾项目），不打也不通知
items.den: Skip (and do not notify) NFTs whose tokenURI is empty or fake

items.zh: 自动取消无限额度授权
items.dzh: 每 10 分钟巡一次钱包授权（全部列出、新的会通知）。开了：所有「无限额度」授权都自动取消，只有你填在下面「不自动取消的合约」的不取消（交易所路由也会被取消，下次交易时钱包会再要授权）；关掉 = 只通知
items.den: Every 10 min all wallet approvals are listed and new ones reported. On: every unlimited approval is revoked except spenders you list below (exchange routers too — the wallet asks again next trade). Off = report only

items.dzh: 填合约地址（0x 开头，用逗号分开）；这些授权就算是无限额度也不自动取消。没填 = 全部无限授权都取消
items.den: Spender addresses (0x…, comma separated) whose unlimited approvals are never auto-revoked. Empty = revoke all unlimited approvals

items.zh: 禁止跟 Flap 合约互动
items.dzh: 打开后，铸造、授权都不碰 Flap 的合约，发现授权给 Flap 会自动取消
items.den: When on, never interact with or approve Flap contracts (approvals are revoked)

items.zh: 手续费型铸造每天最多花
items.dzh: 每个钱包每天花在「要付手续费的免费铸造」＋gas 的 BNB 上限
items.den: Per wallet per day: BNB for fee-type mints plus gas

items.dzh: 每个钱包每天最多花多少 BNB（单位 BNB）
items.den: BNB per wallet per day

items.zh: 单笔 gas 太贵就不打
items.en: Skip if gas is too high
items.dzh: 预估 gas 超过下面的数字就不打（避免被故意做成很耗 gas 的合约）
items.den: Skip if the estimated gas exceeds the numbers below

items.zh: 手续费型铸造 gas 最多
items.dzh: 要付手续费的免费铸造，每笔 gas 最多（单位 BNB）
items.den: Gas per fee-type mint (BNB)

items.zh: 付费铸造 gas 最多
items.dzh: 付费铸造每笔 gas 最多（单位 BNB）
items.den: Gas per paid mint (BNB)

items.zh: 同一个合约失败几次就停
items.dzh: 同一个合约当天上链失败到下面的次数就不再试（避免一直烧 gas）
items.den: Stop retrying a contract after this many on-chain failures today

items.dzh: 当天失败几次就停（单位 次）
items.den: Failures per day

items.zh: 免费铸造每天最多打几个
items.dzh: 「免费铸造自动打」打开时，每个钱包每天最多自动打几个免费项目
items.den: When free auto-mint is on: max free projects per wallet per day

items.dzh: 每个钱包每天最多几个（单位 个）
items.den: Projects per wallet per day

items.zh: 每天最多亏多少就暂停
items.dzh: 今天卖出的币合计亏超过下面的数字，全部自动买暂停（卖出照常）
items.den: If today’s realised loss exceeds the number below, all auto-buys pause (sells continue)

items.den: In U

items.den: Pause buying after this many losing sells in a row

items.dzh: 单位 笔
items.den: Trades

items.zh: 手动／一键买的亏损也算进去
items.dzh: 打开后，「每天最多亏」和「连亏几笔」也会把你自己手动买的亏损算进去
items.den: Daily-loss fuse and losing streak also count your manual buys

items.dzh: 打开后，只在下面的时段内自动买（例如睡觉时不打）。卖出不受影响
items.den: Auto-buy only within the hours below. Sells are unaffected

items.den: 24h clock

items.den: 24 = midnight; can wrap, e.g. 22 to 6

items.en: BNB Chain: who counts as a real buyer
items.dzh: AI 热门代币、一般新币的「真实买家至少」用这个定义。没开 = 所有买家都算
items.den: Used by “real buyers” of hot/new tokens. Off = every buyer counts

items.dzh: 钱包交易次数到这个才算真人（单位 笔）
items.den: Wallet tx count to count as real

items.dzh: 钱包里要有这么多 BNB 才算真人（单位 BNB）
items.den: BNB in wallet to count as real

items.en: BNB Chain: what counts as a bundle
items.dzh: AI 热门代币、一般新币的「捆绑钱包最多」用这个定义：开盘一起买的、新开钱包、买一样数量的。没开 = 捆绑一律算 0%，「捆绑钱包最多」等于没作用
items.den: Used by “max bundle” of hot/new tokens. Off = bundle counts as 0% (that rule has no effect)

items.zh: 开盘后几个区块内买的
items.en: Bought within N blocks of open
items.dzh: 开盘后这么多个区块内买的算捆绑（池子是 6 小时内开的才算得出来；单位 块）
items.den: Buys within this many blocks of pool open (block)

items.dzh: 前 50 大里交易次数不超过这个的算新开钱包（单位 笔）
items.den: Top-50 holders with at most this many txs are fresh

items.zh: 买一样数量的钱包几个以上
items.dzh: 这么多个以上的钱包买入数量一样，就都算捆绑（单位 个）
items.den: This many wallets buying the same amount count as a bundle

items.zh: 自动买卖：预演判断不安全也照送
items.en: Auto: send even if the preview looks unsafe
items.dzh: 自动铸造／自动买卖送出前，工具会先预演一次。预演判断「不安全」（例如会扣到别的币、会授权、扣的钱比说好的多、拿不到东西）时：关＝只记录、这笔不送；开＝仍然送出，并发 TG 告诉你（可能白烧 gas、拿不到东西或被扣更多钱）。预演根本没成功（钱包没给送出编号）的单永远送不出去。手动下的单不看这个开关：会弹窗问你要不要「我知道风险，仍然执行」
items.den: Before an automatic mint/trade is sent, the tool previews it. If the preview looks unsafe (other tokens taken, approvals, more spent than agreed, nothing received): off = log only, not sent; on = send anyway and notify you on TG (you may waste gas, get nothing or pay more). A preview that did not succeed at all cannot be sent. Manual orders ignore this switch and ask you instead.

items.zh: 自动交易：允许「授权」给别的地址
items.en: Auto: allow approvals to other addresses
items.dzh: 有些铸造／买卖会顺便「授权」（approve）你的代币给别的合约。授权后对方可以随时转走你这个代币，可能是盗币。关＝自动交易遇到授权只记录、不送；开＝照送，每次都写日志并发 TG（附取消授权的方法）。「预演不安全也照送」不包含这个，要另外开。手动下单不看这个开关：会弹出警告，要你勾「我看懂了」再按「仍然执行」。外挂（plugins）不适用：外挂一律不能送授权（包含 Permit 签名）
items.den: Some mints/trades also approve your tokens to another contract, which can then take that token at any time (possible theft). Off = automatic trades with an approval are logged, not sent; on = sent, logged and reported on TG every time (with how to revoke). Not covered by “send even if preview looks unsafe”. Manual orders ignore this switch and show a strong warning instead. Add-ons (plugins) are not covered: they can never send approvals/Permit.

items.dzh: 关掉 = BNB Chain AI 铸造项目只通知不打（要自己打开才会买）
items.den: Off = BNB Chain AI mint projects are alerts only

items.dzh: 只观察：照你的条件判断、写判断日志，条件都过了发 TG 通知，不买（不用填金额）
items.den: Watch only: judged by your conditions and logged; a TG alert when everything passes, no buying (no amounts needed)

items.dzh: 每个钱包每个铸造项目最多花多少（单位 U）。没填就不会自动打
items.den: Max spend per wallet per project (U). Empty = no auto-mint

items.dzh: 每个钱包每天花在铸造项目的总上限（单位 U；付费、转 BNB、手续费型都算）。没填就不会自动打
items.den: Daily total per wallet on mint projects (U). Empty = no auto-mint

items.dzh: 下面开着的条件要怎么算才买。没选就不会买（底线不参加组合，开着的底线一定要过）
items.den: How the conditions below decide a buy. Not chosen = never buys (floors are separate and must always pass)

items.den: Between 1 and the number of conditions you have on

items.zh: 铸造进度要到多少才打
items.dzh: 进度到这里才打（太早容易被项目方钓鱼）
items.den: Only mint after progress reaches this

items.zh: 频道贴的免费铸造直接排队打
items.en: Auto-queue free mints posted in channels
items.dzh: 你监测的 TG 频道贴的合约如果是免费铸造，直接替每个钱包排队铸造。没开＝只加进追踪
items.den: Queue free mints posted in your watched channels for every wallet. Off = track only
items.xzh: 已关掉「免费铸造只通知、不自动打」（两个不能同时开）
items.xen: Turned off “Free mints: notify only” (they conflict)

items.zh: 空投截止／领取日 TG 提醒
items.dzh: 你清单里的空投：截止前一天、领取日当天发 TG。没开＝不发
items.den: TG on the day before a deadline and on claim day. Off = none

items.zh: 空投「可以领了」TG 提醒
items.dzh: 你清单里追踪的空投，airdrops.io 显示可以领了就发一次 TG。没开＝不发
items.den: One TG when a tracked airdrop shows claimable on airdrops.io. Off = none

items.zh: 空投「查到融资」TG 提醒
items.dzh: 你清单里追踪的空投查到融资资讯就发一次 TG（附来源原文）。没开＝不发
items.den: One TG when funding info is found for a tracked airdrop (with source text). Off = none

items.dzh: 清单里的挖矿项目有写开始时间的，到点发一次 TG（附资料里写的风险提醒）。只是提醒，雷达不会帮你挖。没开＝不发
items.den: One TG when a mining item with a start time starts (with any risk note). Reminder only. Off = none

items.dzh: 有新版时发一次 TG。没开＝不发 TG（雷达画面的新版提示照样有）
items.den: One TG when a new version is out. Off = no TG (the in-app notice still shows)

items.dzh: 官方标「重要」的新版，雷达会自己下载、验签名后更新（设定都保留）。开这个＝只提醒、你自己按才更新
items.den: Critical versions install themselves after the official signature check (settings kept). On = notice only, you press update yourself

items.dzh: 每日总结、新版提醒里附上官方 TG 群连结。没开＝不附
items.den: Append the official TG group link to daily summary / update notices. Off = not shown

items.zh: 学到免费打法但大家都在付费 → 改学付费
items.en: Relearn paid mint when others pay
items.dzh: 学到的是免费那份，但其他人都在付费铸造时，自动改学付费的打法。没开＝照学到的打法，不会自己换
items.den: If the learned way is free but others pay, relearn the paid way. Off = keep the learned way

items.dzh: ToshX 新项目通知里列出查到的事实（官网资料有没有、有没有推特／官网、同一个创建者发过几个）。没开＝不列
items.den: List found facts in ToshX alerts (site data, X/website present, creator count). Off = not listed

items.dzh: 模拟卖出失败（可能是貔貅）的币在画面上标红色。没开＝只用一般文字标示
items.den: Show honeypot (sell simulation failed) labels in red. Off = plain label

items.dzh: 空投网址是常被拿来钓鱼的网域结尾时，加一行提醒。没开＝不提醒
items.den: Add a warning line when an airdrop link uses a domain ending often used for phishing. Off = none

items.zh: 推算「每份几颗」：几笔一样的数量才算
items.en: Infer per-share amount: same amount at least
items.dzh: 读不到合约的每份数量时，看最近的铸造转帐，几笔一样才当成每份几颗。空白＝不推算（进度读不到）
items.den: When per-share amount is unreadable, how many identical recent mint transfers count. Empty = no inference (progress unreadable)

items.dzh: 手机页送来的买入、铸造单，引擎会再检查一次：要开这个、并填每天最多花多少 U。没开＝手机只能看、卖，不能买。手机不能确认「授权」类的单（一律要在电脑上做）
items.den: Phone buy/mint orders are re-checked by the engine: turn this on and set a daily USD cap. Off = the phone can view and sell only. Approval confirmations are never accepted from the phone

items.zh: 手机每天最多花多少 U
items.dzh: 手机下的买入／铸造单当天合计（送出时就算进去，结果不明的也算）。超过就不执行。空白＝手机不能买
items.den: Total of phone buy/mint orders per day (counted when sent). Over the cap = not executed. Empty = phone cannot buy

items.zh: 主钱包断线时改用另一个钱包
items.en: Use the other wallet when the main wallet is offline
items.dzh: 连了两个以上钱包时：一般代币平常用「主钱包」买（在 设定 → 钱包 选）；主钱包登入过期时，打开这个就改用另一个有登入的钱包，没开＝不买。AI 专属项目一律只用币安钱包，卖出一律用当初买进的钱包
items.den: With two or more wallets: normal tokens buy with the main wallet (pick it in Settings → Wallets). If the main wallet is logged out, this switches to another logged-in wallet; off = don't buy. AI-only projects always use the Binance wallet; sells always use the wallet that bought

items.dzh: 市价单和限价单没另外指定滑点（或用币安自动滑点）时，一律用下面的滑点；策略自己算的滑点、重试滑点、Robinhood 卖出滑点照旧优先。没开＝币安钱包自动滑点
items.den: Used for market and limit orders that have no slippage of their own (or use wallet auto slippage); strategy / retry / Robinhood sell slippage still win. Off = wallet auto slippage

items.dzh: 单位 %
items.den: In %

items.dzh: 币安钱包预设会开防夹（防三明治攻击）。打开这个＝送单时关掉防夹（可能比较快，但容易被夹）。Solana 不适用
items.den: The wallet protects against sandwich attacks by default. On = send without MEV protection (may be faster, but can be sandwiched). Not for Solana

items.dzh: 送单用高档手续费（比较快上链）。跟「Gas 用低档」只能开一个；都没开＝币安钱包预设的中档
items.den: Send with high gas (faster). Only one of high / low; neither = wallet default (medium)

items.dzh: 送单用低档手续费（比较省，但可能比较慢）。跟「Gas 用高档」只能开一个
items.den: Send with low gas (cheaper, may be slower). Only one of high / low

items.dzh: 市价单送出超过下面的秒数还没成交 → 用币安钱包把同一笔交易提高手续费重送一次（不会多买）。只限 EVM 链
items.den: If a market order is still pending after the seconds below, resend the same transaction once with higher gas (never buys twice). EVM chains only

items.dzh: 单位 秒
items.den: Seconds

items.zh: 挖矿池子流动性到了提醒我

items.den: When the reward-token pool liquidity of a mining project you joined enters your range, send one TG + in-app alert (with risk note). Unreadable = no alert. Reminder only

items.zh: 自动挖 AGC（agcc.fun 免费挖）
items.dzh: 开着＋下面的份数有填，雷达每天帮每个钱包挖：押 BNB 换份数，到期自动领回 BNB＋AGC。每份押多少、押多久，照合约链上读到的显示在「⛏ AI挖矿」的 AGC 卡片。钱包要有 Agent ID；要开右上角自动买总开关；每一笔送出前先预演，只准扣说好的 BNB、不准有授权。没开＝不挖（雷达自己挖的那几笔照样到期领回）
items.den: On + a share count below: each day the radar mints for each wallet — lock BNB for shares, then claims the BNB back plus AGC when due. The price per share and lock time are read from the contract and shown on the AGC card under “⛏ AI mining”. The wallet needs an Agent ID and the auto-buy master switch must be on; every send is simulated first (only the agreed BNB may leave, no approvals). Off = no mining (deposits the radar made are still claimed back when due)

items.zh: 每个钱包每天最多挖几份
items.en: Max shares per wallet per day
items.dzh: 包括你自己在 agcc.fun 挖的；合约给的额度比较少时照合约的。要填正整数；空白＝不挖
items.den: Includes shares you mint yourself on agcc.fun; if the contract allows fewer, the contract wins. Whole number; empty = no mining

items.zh: AGC 池子流动性介于（下限）
items.dzh: 选填条件：AGC 池子流动性在你填的范围内才挖；空白＝不设下限。填了但读不到流动性＝不挖
items.den: Optional: mine only while the AGC pool liquidity is in your range; empty = no lower bound. Set but unreadable = no mining

items.zh: AGC 池子流动性介于（上限）
items.dzh: 空白＝不设上限（两个都空白＝不看池子）
items.den: Empty = no upper bound (both empty = pool not checked)

items.den: One TG alert if a due deposit still can’t be claimed after this long; empty = no alert (keeps retrying)

items.dzh: 打开后雷达只向下面的节点「读」区块，列出 Elysium 上新铸出的代币（看盘 → 🌐 Elysium）。不连钱包、不签名、不送交易、没有买卖。关着＝完全不连线。主网 11/9 前是偷跑链，资料来自社群节点

items.dzh: 选用：多扫一层。「🆕 新发射台」本来就会列出 AVE 看盘里的发行平台和 AI 热门代币的发射台；打开这个，雷达还会向公开节点「读」区块，把最近发了很多新币的合约也列出来（公开节点有用量限制，读不到时会自己重试）。不连钱包、不签名、不送交易、不会自动买

No wallet, no signing, never buys

items.zh: 自动参与 Pol · Proof of Liquidity
items.dzh: 开着＋下面三个数字都有填，雷达每天帮每个钱包参与：每份付 BNB，合约拿一半买 Pol、一半配对成 LP 锁住，Pol 奖励在锁仓期间线性释放。每份价格、锁多久、开池了没，照合约链上读到的显示在「⛏ AI挖矿」的 Pol 卡片。钱包要有 Agent ID；要开右上角自动买总开关；每一笔送出前先模拟＋预演，只准扣说好的 BNB、不准有授权。高风险项目，卡片有红字提示。没开＝不参与
items.den: On + all three numbers below: each day the radar joins for each wallet — each share costs BNB; the contract buys Pol with half and pairs the rest into locked LP, and Pol rewards vest linearly over the lock. Price, lock time and pool status are read from the contract and shown on the Pol card under “⛏ AI mining”. The wallet needs an Agent ID and the auto-buy master switch must be on; every send is simulated and previewed first (only the agreed BNB may leave, no approvals). High-risk project — see the red notice on the card. Off = no joining

items.zh: 每个钱包每天最多参与几份
items.en: Max shares per wallet per day
items.dzh: 包括你自己在 proofmine.fun 参与的；合约给的额度比较少时照合约的。要填正整数；空白＝不参与
items.den: Includes shares you join yourself on proofmine.fun; if the contract allows fewer, the contract wins. Whole number; empty = no joining

items.dzh: 每一笔交易参与几份（不会超过上面「每天最多」剩下的份数）。要填正整数；空白＝不参与
items.den: Shares in each transaction (never more than what is left of the daily max above). Whole number; empty = no joining

items.dzh: 参与／退出时，最少要拿到「现在估的数量 ×（1 − 你填的 %）」，不然合约直接拒绝（只花 gas）。参与和「到期退出」都要用；空白＝不参与、也不退出
items.den: When joining / exiting you must get at least “current estimate × (1 − your %)”, otherwise the contract rejects it (gas only). Needed for joining and for “exit when due”; empty = no joining and no exiting

opts.zh: 领回原始 LP（LP 代币进你的钱包）
opts.en: Claim the raw LP (LP tokens to your wallet)

opts.zh: 退出（移除流动性，换回 Pol＋BNB）
opts.en: Exit (remove liquidity, back to Pol + BNB)

items.en: What to do with the LP when due
items.dzh: 两个互斥（合约规定只能选一种）。退出时 Pol 直接到帐、BNB 先记在合约，雷达会接着帮你提回钱包。没选＝LP 不动（只领奖励），你可以自己到 proofmine.fun 处理
items.den: Mutually exclusive (the contract allows only one). On exit Pol arrives directly and the BNB is credited in the contract; the radar then withdraws it to your wallet. Not chosen = LP untouched (rewards only); you can handle it yourself on proofmine.fun

items.zh: 关掉自动参与后，到期仍帮我领回（只领、不再参与）
items.en: After auto-join is off, still claim when due (claim only, no joining)
items.dzh: 开着＝自动参与关掉后，雷达参与的那几笔照样到期领奖励、照上面的选择处理 LP（只收不付，紧急全停也能领）。自动参与开着时，这个钱包所有到期的仓位都会领
items.den: On = after auto-join is turned off, the positions the radar opened are still claimed when due and the LP handled as chosen above (receive-only; works even during emergency stop). While auto-join is on, every due position of the wallet is claimed
